desc.zh: 手算括号配对，再用未匹配下标和排除边界求最长连续合法片段。
desc.en: Work through pairing by hand, then retain unmatched indices and an excluded boundary to find the longest valid contiguous fragment.

concepts.name: Validity by hand
concepts.description: Trace balance from each candidate start; reject negative prefixes and require a zero ending.

concepts.name: Excluded boundary stack
concepts.description: Retain unmatched opening indices and an uncrossable closing boundary to avoid rescanning.

concepts.name: Reversible parenthesis scan
concepts.description: Compare pop, boundary reset, current valid suffix length and historical best.
